title: 8TH EDITION OF INDIA–MYANMAR NAVAL EXERCISE (IMNEX-26) COMMENCES AT VISAKHAPATNAM
body_text: The 8th edition of the India–Myanmar Naval Exercise (IMNEX-26) is being conducted at Visakhapatnam from 10 to 14 Nov 2026. Myanmar Navy Ship UMS King Sin Phyu Shin arrived at Visakhapatnam on 10 Nov 2026 to participate in the exercise alongside INS Rana and INS Sumedha. The Opening Ceremony was held onboard INS Rana on 10 Nov 2026, marking the commencement of the bilateral exercise. IMNEX serves as an important platform for advancing maritime cooperation between the two neighbouring countries. The exercise provides an opportunity for both the Navies to exchange professional expertise, enhance mutual understanding and develop greater operational synergy. The Harbour Phase includes professional interactions, Subject Matter Expert Exchanges (SMEEs), cross-deck visits, sporting engagements and discussions on operational matters. The subsequent Sea Phase will involve coordinated maritime operations, tactical manoeuvres and exercises aimed at enhancing interoperability between the participating units. IMNEX-26 underscores the enduring friendship and maritime partnership between India and Myanmar. The exercise is aligned with India's vision of MAHASAGAR (Mutual and Holistic Advancement for Security and Growth Across Regions) and reflects the shared commitment of both Navies to maritime cooperation and a secure and stable regional environment. **** VM/AS
